title: Obordeleau reviews export
description: Shape expected at content/reviews.json. Validated by scripts/check-reviews.mjs.

listing_id.description: Airbnb listing the export was taken from.

source_url.description: Public page the export was taken from.

locale.description: Locale the listing page was read in. Says nothing about the language of any one review.

total_reviews.description: Count announced by the listing, which can exceed the entries actually exported.

reviews.description: The entries themselves. This is the key src/lib/reviews.ts reads and the one scripts/check-reviews.mjs validates.

id.description: Zero padded, 001 to 165. Also the avatar filename stem.

reviewer_name.description: Only the first token is displayed (RGPD data minimisation, constitution VI).

date.description: Human readable month + year as exported. Optional if date_iso is present.

review_fr.description: Original review text. Despite the field name some entries are EN or DE. Never machine retranslated.

lang.description: Optional. Detected at load time when absent.

image_filename.description: Avatar file under public/images/reviews/, for example 033.jpg.
